title: Quaint Creamy Peruvian Shrimp Chupe De Camarones
description: A peppery and creamy Peruvian dish featuring tamarind paste, this recipe is a crowd-pleaser and perfect for special occasions, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients and cooked in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Pound the onion, garlic, and ginger in a mortar and pestle until well combined.
Heat the mixture in a pan over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the tamarind paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the shrimp and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Spoon the mixture onto the center of a banana leaf.
Fold the banana leaf over the mixture to form a packet and secure with a toothpick.
Serve the packets hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
